verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents the Client Credentials flow for machine clients, which authenticate with a Client ID and Secret to receive an Access Token, and it states that authorization uses 'scopes and granular permissions' for machine-to-machine communication. It also offers a unique digital identity per AI agent and delegated OAuth access built to stop agents having 'broad, unrestricted access', with Token Vault handling third-party tokens so agents never hold raw API keys. missing for 10: detailed docs on how scopes or permissions are granted to a specific agent client (only marketing-level snippets), credential lifecycle controls such as rotation, expiry or revocation for agent credentials, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
